column1: Security Check after Failed Attempts per IP Address

column1: Failed user logins from one IP address after which the Back Office, Merchant Portal and agent logins ask for a security check (CAPTCHA) while the CAPTCHA is on in the After Failed Attempts mode (Security, CAPTCHA tab). If this number is not below the lock of that IP address, the security check comes one login before the lock. Whether the CAPTCHA is on or off, only this many failed logins from one IP address count toward the limit across all accounts. 0 turns both off, for example when all users reach the shop through one proxy IP address. A whole number from 0 to 1000.

column1: Failed user logins across all accounts within the time window below, after which every Back Office, Merchant Portal and agent login asks for a security check (CAPTCHA) while the CAPTCHA is on in the After Failed Attempts mode (Security, CAPTCHA tab). This slows down attacks that try a few passwords on many accounts. Whether the CAPTCHA is on or off, reaching this number writes an entry to the security audit log while that log is enabled. 0 turns both off. A whole number from 0 to 100000.
